items.title: SpaceX launches 3 giant BlueBird direct-to-cell satellites on Falcon 9 rocket
items.excerpt: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launched three of AST SpaceMobile's huge BlueBird direct-to-cell satellites to low Earth orbit early on Wednesday morning (Aug. 5).

items.title: AST SpaceMobile Launches Three BlueBird Satellites Into Orbit
items.excerpt: AST SpaceMobile successfully launched BlueBird satellites 11, 12, and 13, expanding its next-generation satellite communications network.

items.title: A Meta Executive Just Gave AST SpaceMobile a Shoutout. What It Means for ASTS Stock.
items.excerpt: AST SpaceMobile shares rose 10.69% on August 4 after a Meta executive revealed a technical workshop exploring how WhatsApp could operate over the company’s satellite network for messaging, voice, video, and AI features on standard smartphones.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile Is Entering Its Defining Year
items.excerpt: AST SpaceMobile has secured $3.8 billion of liquidity, accelerated manufacturing and maintained its $150-200 million 2026 revenue guidance despite launch...

items.title: AST SpaceMobile Makes History in 5G Broadband Cellular Connectivity from Space
items.excerpt: First-ever 5G connection for voice and data between an everyday, unmodified smartphone and a satellite in space.

items.title: T-Mobile Takes Coverage Above and Beyond With SpaceX
items.excerpt: T-Mobile and SpaceX announce Coverage Above and Beyond using Starlink direct-to-cell connectivity.
